items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: A group that Al Cohn named, it was Gene Quill and Phil Woods, he called them Leopold and Loeb.

ctx.x: Yeah, so instead of the Tijuana Brass they called them the Marijuana Reeds.
